prompt: Create workspace/slug.py with a function slugify(text) that follows the rules in workspace/SPEC.md, and add your own tests in workspace/test_slug.py. Run your tests before you finish.

fixtures.content:
# slugify(text)

Turn a title into a URL slug.

1. Lowercase the text.
2. Transliterate accented letters to plain ASCII (é -> e, ñ -> n, ü -> u).
3. Replace every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 with one hyphen.
4. Remove leading and trailing hyphens.
5. Truncate to at most 40 characters, then remove any trailing hyphen the cut leaves behind.
6. If nothing is left, return "untitled".

solution.content:
import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(text):
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", text).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower()).strip("-")
    text = text[:40].rstrip("-")
    return text or "untitled"
